description:
## Founding root
Synthesis of all founding mechanisms: the alignment essay's congress (¶8–¶18) with typed consequences, credibility, escalation reports and one-directional flow; the introspection essay's checkpoint/rewind (FI-I03) as containment. Plan §21 'Revision 0.2 critical path' defines the base vertical slice; this epic extends it with the revision 0.3 founding mechanisms.

## Context (self-contained)
Plan §21 names the next implementable vertical slice: one immutable artifact review, one mock then real brokered write, witness invalidation under concurrent metadata changes, exact cut-checking of a small authority graph, a helper view commitment, and replay of the held/allowed decision. Revision 0.3 adds the founding congress and containment mechanisms. This epic is the end-to-end test that all of them compose: an untrusted coding agent proposes publishing a package (plan §0 flagship); a reporting helper files an EscalationReport bound to an evidence-view manifest; a frozen commit–reveal round with capped weights and one exact disqualifier (forbidden destination) reduces to `Deny` for that attempt while a second, non-disqualified attempt is held (`HoldEffect`) pending evidence; the actor receives only a refusal code (one-directional filter); a counterfactual branch with zero production authority removes the suspect dependency; a second round reduces to `ResetToCheckpoint` + `NarrowAuthority`; the actor is restored from a pre-incident checkpoint (mock host profile with `functional_restart` grade), the ledger and incident counter are verified unchanged/incremented; the decision closure is replayed at `decision_replay` grade and recomputes byte-identical consequences. Every step logs a structured event; the run produces a single JSON evidence bundle under `artifacts/execution/`. No real credentials, no network: the 'real' brokered write targets a disposable local directory through the broker, exactly as packet FA-012 requires.

## Deliverable
A scenario driver `fa-sim::scenarios::founding_slice` (or a test binary under `crates/fa-sim/tests/`) with a fixed seed, mock deterministic helpers (one reporter, three members in two cohorts), a mock host profile exposing `functional_restart`, a disposable local publication adapter, and an `EventLog` type emitting one JSON line per step: `{step, run, action, attempt, round, consequence, units: {available, reserved, spent}, incident_count, epoch, evidence_root, closure_digest}`.

## Design notes and considerations
Keep every input in the seed and the scenario file so a second run reproduces byte-identical logs; the log format is the evidence bundle's schema.

## Acceptance criteria
Two runs with the same seed produce identical event logs (diff empty).

## Tests (must land with the change)
Determinism test (two runs, compare); schema test for the event line.

## Logging and evidence
The event log is the deliverable; retained under `artifacts/execution/<date>-founding-slice.jsonl`.

**Constitution reminders (AGENTS.md):** Rust 2024, latest qualified nightly, `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`, Asupersync runtime, closed dependency universe, no C/ONNX/libtorch/Python. Observations, judgments and authority are different types; missing evidence never increases authority; rights are never copied into a branch; unknown effects are never refunded by cancellation; old revocation floors are never restored. Verify with `cargo run --locked -p xtask -- check`; retain logs under `artifacts/execution/`; a dry run is not execution. Update the roadmap packet, IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md, CHANGELOG.md and the founding concordance in the same change.

description:
## Founding root
Engineering addition serving the alignment essay's demand for hard evidence (FI-A06), stop-the-line economics and least expenditure (FI-A13, FI-A17), and the introspection essay's 'language as debugger' and rewindable graph (FI-I18, FI-I03, FI-I15). Plan §6.7, §6.8, §17.2, §17.3, §17.8, §17.11, §17.12.

## Context (self-contained)
The system is stated as nine layers, each answering one question and depending only downward: L0 identity (what exactly is this thing), L1 observation (what was seen and not seen), L2 evidence (what can be relied on, under which assumptions), L3 judgment (what independent observers conclude, at what cost), L4 authority (what may happen now), L5 effect (what happened in the world), L6 closure (why, verifiably), L7 experiment (what would have happened otherwise), L8 governance (is the control system itself still trustworthy). Five rules: downward dependence only; one epistemic type `Knowledge<T>` (Known with basis, Pending{frontier}, Unknown{reason}, Withheld{authority}, Stale{generation}, Absent{closed_domain}) at every boundary; one address scheme `fa://<tenant>/<kind>/<id>[@gen]` resolved by `fa get`/`fa related`; one typed journal per authority domain that situation, explanation, replay and the risk-theater detector fold over; executable conformance contracts between layers composed bottom-up by `fa doctor` (anything above an unexecuted suite is Unknown{LowerLayerUnverified}). The agent surface is the tower's projection: verbs get/related/capabilities/when/invalidate/explain/cost/convene/annotate/situation/why-held/next/tail/propose/precheck/hold/narrow/suspend/reset/fence/resolve/verify/handoff/replay-plan/branch/intervene/replay/rehearse/doctor/ledger/findings/policy-replay/promote/rotate/preregister; every mutation names an expected predecessor and idempotency key; every response is the envelope of plan §17.3 with typed affordances; every error names `would_change_this`.

`docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md` holds the playbooks (first ten minutes; hold; incident; unknown outcome; helper selection; autonomy; policy change; experiment; fleet fence; handoff) as sequences of registered verbs with consumed/produced addresses and failure branches. The system-map checker fails on any retired verb in the guide; once rehearsal mode exists, each playbook is rehearsed end to end in a branch as a test.

## Deliverable
Each step: verb, inputs (addresses), outputs (addresses/types), failure branches with reason codes; a small YAML/JSON sidecar `docs/playbooks/*.json` mirrors the prose.

## Design notes and considerations
Prose from structure.

## Acceptance criteria
Sidecars exist for all playbooks.

## Tests (must land with the change)
Checker validates sidecars.

## Logging and evidence
n/a

**Constitution reminders (AGENTS.md):** Rust 2024, latest qualified nightly, `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`, Asupersync runtime, closed dependency universe. Observations, judgments and authority are different types; missing evidence never increases authority. The system is one tower (plan §6.7): a new object lives in exactly one layer; every agent-facing value is a `Knowledge` variant, never a bare scalar (FA-INV-039); every command is a registered verb in `registry/vocabulary.json` with authority, class, idempotency and cost; rehearsal never permits (FA-INV-040). Verify with `cargo run --locked -p xtask -- check`; retain logs under `artifacts/execution/`. Update roadmap packet, IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md, CHANGELOG.md, the founding concordance and the system map in the same change.
